meta.name: paid-ads-optimize
meta.description: Diagnose wasted paid-ad spend, pacing, and allocation, then propose safe evidence-backed optimizations. Use for waste, negatives, budgets, bid changes, poor CPA or ROAS, underpacing, overspend, or scaling decisions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别广告浪费花费，给出可落地的优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果广告费花得不明不白，转化却不理想
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose wasted ad spend and get evidence-based optimization ideas
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your ad spend is rising without better results

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先诊断付费广告的浪费点,核实转化数据后再提优化建议;建议按可逆程度排序(先排除无关流量、暂停最差单元、再调预算/出价);每次改动给出当前值、建议值、理由和复核日期,获批后通过已验证的平台技能执行并记录。
howto.when: 当你说到广告浪费、预算/出价调整、CPA/ROAS 不佳等支出问题,或要求做扩量/缩量等决策时触发。

say.text: 帮我找出最近广告支出里最浪费的部分,提出优化方案。
say.note: Claude 会先要数据,再给建议。

say.text: 预算从 A 组挪到 B 组,总额不变,帮我排优先级。
say.note: 会给出当前与建议分配及理由。

say.text: 点击很多但转化差,怀疑是落地页问题,帮我诊断。
say.note: 会先排查落地页再谈投放。

howto.what_en: Claude diagnoses wasted ad spend, pacing, and allocation, verifies conversion data, then suggests reversible optimizations. Each change shows current/proposed values, rationale, and review date; after approval it executes through the verified platform skill and records the expected effect.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention wasted spend, budget/bid changes, poor CPA/ROAS, or ask for scaling decisions.

say_en.text: Find the most wasteful part of my recent ad spend and propose optimizations.
say_en.note: Claude will request data first, then advise.

say_en.text: Shift budget from campaign A to B without increasing total; rank the changes.
say_en.note: It will show current vs proposed allocations.

say_en.text: Many clicks but poor conversions; could the landing page be the issue?
say_en.note: It checks landing-page failures before blaming targeting.
